items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: sitting up on drums for Benny

ctx.x: But he used to call me quite regular when I was in New York, see.
Yeah, I know it means an awful lot to Benny to have somebody sitting up on drums that takes care of business. I always did, with him, and it sounds understandable, doesn't it?
Like when he went to Russia.
